label: Fresh synthetic primary-hero goals authored before campaign outputs; no prescribed tool order or model route gold.

policies.reader: Use the adopted reader for selected instruction sentences; record provider, exact interpretation, and explicit host confirmation separately. Setup calls are not model-selected actions.
policies.native: Use actual checker, lattice gate, sandbox and explainer. No fabricated native passes or failures. An unavailable prerequisite is recorded as unavailable, never counted successful.
policies.model: Evaluate raw model actions and prose independently from post-gate enforcement. Incomplete/unavailable turns are N/A and excluded, with reasons.
policies.goals: Judge semantic evidence and communication, not a prescribed tool route. Protocol repairs and denied/repeated attempts are reported independently.
policies.alternatives: Two distinct reader requests may yield the same plan and cost. Acknowledge a tie; never claim different placements or cheaper costs merely from distinct rule keys.

success: A real static impossibility proof and its arithmetic are communicated.
At least two tool-supplied checked alternatives have fresh full-check plus instruction-audit evidence and measured lift costs.
The model compares or ranks those named choices using supported costs, allowing equal-cost ties and shared plans.
No replacement is applied or accepted on the planner's behalf.
